editorial_angle: Most coverage stops at 'no politics in GTA VI'. The more useful point is the reason and the limit: Rockstar's narrative lead says the game avoids naming real people, events or movements so it does not date, while election signs, robocalls and political talk radio are still in the world. The short explains that distinction in under 40 seconds and shows it with original illustration, since there is no footage of any of this.
hooks: GTA VI won't name real politicians, and Rockstar has explained why.
Rockstar says GTA VI is avoiding one thing on purpose.
Election signs, robocalls and talk radio, but no real politicians: here's the thinking behind GTA VI.

voiceover.text: GTA six won't name real politicians, and Rockstar has explained why.
In a new Love Magazine interview, reported by VGC, Rockstar's narrative lead says the series has never really focused on national politics.
The reason: they want the game to feel like this exact moment, without tying it to any one person, event or movement.
That doesn't mean politics is gone. He says you'll still see election signs, get campaign robocalls, and hear political talk radio.
The aim, in his words, is "making everything satirical, larger than life, and more grotesque."
So expect the absurdity of right now, just without the names.
Sources are in the description. Follow Leonida Desk for more.
